facts.fact: Lei n.º 45/X/2024, the 2025 State Budget law of Cabo Verde, appropriates CVE 122,073,633 for the Fundo de Serviço Universal e Desenvolvimento da Sociedade de Informação (FUSI), financed by operator contributions and the radio-spectrum fee (earmarked revenue table, item 10).
The document notes FUSI's figure is CVE 122,073,633 in 2024 (proposed), 2025 and 2026, unchanged to the escudo, so the 2025 figure is the same as the year before.

systems.system: Fundo de Serviço Universal e Desenvolvimento da Sociedade de Informação (FUSI)

note: No acted fact: the table prints only the fund's name and amount as counterpart expenditure, with no collection or payment for a project and no creating law stated.
